classes.label: Light scratch
classes.impact: Visible in reflected light; does not affect use.
classes.annotationRule: A linear mark visible only at an angle to the light, with no catch when a fingernail is drawn across it. Annotate each scratch separately while they are countable; switch to MICRO_ABRASION_FIELD past roughly eight in a region.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: A reflection or a dust line. If it moves between the two captures of the same surface it is not a scratch.

classes.label: Deep scratch
classes.impact: Visible under any lighting; reduces resale grade.
classes.annotationRule: A linear mark visible under diffuse light without tilting the device, showing displaced material or a white/bright core.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: CRACK_HAIRLINE, which propagates and has no width.

classes.label: Scuff
classes.impact: Surface marking without material loss.
classes.annotationRule: A non-linear dulled or marked region with no depth.

classes.label: Hairline crack
classes.impact: Glass integrity is compromised; the crack will propagate.
classes.annotationRule: A fracture line through the glass, of no measurable width, following an irregular path. Trace the whole line as a polygon — length is what the scorer needs, and a bounding box of a diagonal crack overstates its area.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: SCRATCH_DEEP, which is straight, has width, and does not branch.

classes.label: Structural crack
classes.impact: Panel replacement required; sealing is compromised.
classes.annotationRule: A fracture with visible width, branching, or an impact origin point.

classes.label: Shattered glass
classes.impact: Panel destroyed; the device is unsafe to handle unrepaired.
classes.annotationRule: Multiple intersecting fractures or missing glass. Mask the affected region rather than each fracture.

classes.label: Chip
classes.impact: Material is missing; often the origin of a later crack.
classes.annotationRule: Material absent from an edge or surface, leaving a void.

classes.label: Gouge
classes.impact: Deep material displacement.
classes.annotationRule: A scratch deep enough to show displaced material at its edges.

classes.label: Dent
classes.impact: Impact deformation; may prevent a panel from seating flush.
classes.annotationRule: A localised depression breaking the frame’s edge line.

classes.label: Bent frame
classes.impact: Chassis deformation; sealing and panel fit are compromised.
classes.annotationRule: A deviation of the frame from a straight line along its length, judged against the opposite edge in the same image.

classes.label: Paint or coating wear
classes.impact: Finish worn through to the substrate.
classes.annotationRule: A region where the coating colour differs from the surrounding frame.

classes.label: Anodising loss
classes.impact: Bare metal exposed; corrosion risk over time.
classes.annotationRule: Bright bare aluminium visible at a corner or edge.

classes.label: Panel separation
classes.impact: A panel is lifting from the chassis; the device is not sealed.
classes.annotationRule: A visible gap between display or rear glass and the frame, wide enough to show a shadow line along its length.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: The normal chamfer highlight, which is continuous and symmetrical on both edges.

classes.label: Lens scratch
classes.impact: Will appear as flare or softness in photographs.
classes.annotationRule: A scratch on the lens cover glass, inside the camera aperture.

classes.label: Lens crack
classes.impact: Photographs are affected; the camera is no longer sealed.
classes.annotationRule: A fracture in the lens cover glass.

classes.label: Shattered lens
classes.impact: Camera unusable without repair.
classes.annotationRule: Multiple fractures or missing glass over the lens.

classes.label: Camera module misalignment
classes.impact: The module does not sit square in its housing.
classes.annotationRule: A lens ring visibly rotated or offset relative to the camera bump, or an uneven gap around the module.

classes.label: Debris inside camera
classes.impact: Particles behind the lens cover; the module has been opened or breached.
classes.annotationRule: Dust or fibres visible behind the lens glass, not on it.

classes.label: Lens coating damage
classes.impact: Anti-reflective coating degraded; increased flare.
classes.annotationRule: Patchy discolouration of the lens surface without a scratch line.

classes.label: Dead pixel cluster
classes.impact: Permanently unlit pixels.
classes.annotationRule: Requires the display-on capture. Dark points that persist across test patterns.

classes.label: Display line
classes.impact: Driver or panel fault; the display needs replacement.
classes.annotationRule: A full-width or full-height line of wrong or absent colour, display on.

classes.label: Burn-in
classes.impact: Permanent ghost image from static UI elements.
classes.annotationRule: A persistent ghost of UI furniture on a flat grey test pattern. Only annotatable from the grey-field capture.

classes.label: Backlight bleed
classes.impact: Uneven brightness at the panel edge.
classes.annotationRule: Brightness gradient from an edge on a black test pattern.

classes.label: Display discolouration
classes.impact: Colour cast across part of the panel.
classes.annotationRule: A region whose colour temperature differs on a white test pattern.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: Camera white balance. Judge only within one image, never across images.

classes.label: Pressure mark
classes.impact: Localised panel damage from applied force.
classes.annotationRule: A bright or discoloured bloom on a grey field, without a surface mark above it.

classes.label: Delamination
classes.impact: Digitiser separating from the panel.
classes.annotationRule: A rainbow or milky region between glass and panel, usually starting at an edge.

classes.label: Micro-abrasion
classes.impact: Fine wear consistent with normal pocket use.
classes.annotationRule: A region of many scratches too numerous to count individually. Mask the region; do not annotate the constituent scratches.

classes.label: Heavy wear
classes.impact: Extensive wear across the surface; grade-limiting.
classes.annotationRule: Dense abrasion covering more than roughly a quarter of the surface.

classes.label: Discolouration
classes.impact: Colour change from heat, chemicals or UV exposure.
classes.annotationRule: A region whose colour differs from the rest of the same panel.

classes.label: Missing screw
classes.impact: A pentalobe screw is absent; the device has been opened.
classes.annotationRule: An empty screw boss beside the charge port.

classes.label: Missing SIM tray
classes.impact: Tray absent; the device is not sealed.
classes.annotationRule: An open SIM aperture with no tray seated.

classes.label: Missing lens ring
classes.impact: The camera trim ring is absent; the module has been worked on.
classes.annotationRule: A lens aperture without its metal trim ring.

classes.label: Missing button
classes.impact: A volume, power or action button is absent.
classes.annotationRule: An empty button aperture in the frame.

classes.label: Non-OEM screw
classes.impact: A replacement screw is fitted; the device has been opened.
classes.annotationRule: A screw whose head type (Phillips, flathead) is not the pentalobe Apple fits, or whose finish differs from its neighbour.

classes.label: Adhesive residue
classes.impact: Aftermarket adhesive is visible at a seam.
classes.annotationRule: Glue visible at a panel seam, or a seam bead of uneven width.

classes.label: Pry mark
classes.impact: Tool marks at a seam; the device has been opened.
classes.annotationRule: Short deformations or bright tool scars along a panel seam.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: Drop damage, which is not confined to the seam line.

classes.label: Uneven panel gap
classes.impact: A panel is not seated to factory tolerance.
classes.annotationRule: A seam whose width varies visibly along its length.

classes.label: Mismatched finish
classes.impact: A component’s colour or texture does not match the rest of the device.
classes.annotationRule: A part whose hue or gloss differs from the adjoining part in the same image under the same light.
classes.notToBeConfusedWith: A lighting gradient. Requires the difference to persist across two views.

classes.label: Aftermarket marking
classes.impact: A repair shop label, engraving or asset tag is present.
classes.annotationRule: Any sticker, engraving or printed mark not applied by the manufacturer.

classes.label: Corrosion
classes.impact: Oxidation present; strongly associated with liquid exposure.
classes.annotationRule: Green, white or powdery deposits on metal, most often inside the charge port.

classes.label: Port debris
classes.impact: Lint or debris in the charge port; may prevent charging until cleared.
classes.annotationRule: Compacted material inside the port cavity.

classes.label: Liquid contact indicator triggered
classes.impact: Apple’s liquid contact indicator has been activated.
classes.annotationRule: The indicator visible in the SIM aperture is red rather than white or silver. Requires the dedicated SIM-slot close-up.

classes.label: Unclassified anomaly
classes.impact: Something is present that does not match any known class.
classes.annotationRule: Applied by a human reviewer only, never predicted at production confidence. Every instance is queued for taxonomy review: this class exists so that unknown damage is *recorded* rather than discarded, and a cluster of them is the signal that the taxonomy needs a new class.

views.label: Front
views.instruction: Device flat, screen off, filling the frame. Angle the light so it does not reflect straight back into the lens.

views.label: Back
views.instruction: Device flat, rear panel filling the frame, camera module fully visible.

views.label: Left edge
views.instruction: Edge-on, volume buttons and SIM tray in frame, whole length visible.

views.label: Right edge
views.instruction: Edge-on, power button in frame, whole length visible.

views.label: Bottom edge
views.instruction: Bottom edge-on, charge port and both screw bosses clearly in frame. Get close enough to read the screw heads.

views.label: Camera module
views.instruction: Close on the camera bump, every lens in frame, no reflection across the glass.

views.label: Display on
views.instruction: Screen showing the DevDNA test pattern at full brightness, filling the frame, photographed square-on.

views.label: Display off
views.instruction: Screen off, photographed square-on under diffuse light.

views.label: Close-up
views.instruction: Close on the area of interest, filling at least half the frame.
